followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain two formal Singkhon–Mawtaung policy observations: withheld general opening and a separately described restricted goods schedule. Neither is promoted to a fully observed all-traffic closure spell. Keep general checkpoint authorisation distinct from community goods exchange and emergency medical exceptions. April’s reported trading-hours relaxation concerns goods conditions and does not establish ordinary passenger admission. Keep both onsets unknown and durations withheld. January 21 is a policy observation; April 17 is the goods arrangement’s reported legal easing. July preparations supply neither actual full reopening nor a new closure date or continuous interval between differently scoped policies. Retain Security / Armed conflict and military confrontation for the stated conflict-related restrictions and easing. Administration and service operation remains limited to the lawful-counterpart problem in P1, with no subcategory assigned. Hua Hin Today reports official meetings, while Daily News reports the governor’s order. These are attributed official policy accounts; signed orders and comprehensive gate operations were not inspected. Exact earlier Hua Hin bodies are reused openly. Retain unlocated Singkhon–Mawtaung crossing/controlled goods-area text and null coordinates. Distinct authorisation, trading-area and checkpoint scopes do not justify a uniform mapped closure.

Audit completion records the review, not universal factual confirmation.
